description: This file defines the Git::SVN::GlobSpec Perl module, which implements pattern matching for glob-style file path specifications, including pattern validation, regex construction, and path resolution.

classes.name: Git::SVN::GlobSpec
classes.description: A Perl class representing glob patterns for file path matching, supporting pattern validation, conversion to regex, and path expansion.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that creates a GlobSpec object from a glob pattern, validating the pattern and compiling it into regex components.

methods.name: full_path
methods.description: Method to generate a full file path based on the glob pattern's left and right parts and a provided relative path.
